method: Decode every episode start at camera-specific timestamps; wrist subtracts 301/30 seconds after episode 2672. Compare fixed robot-colored pixels against the known common reset pose.
limits: Reset-pose visual alignment check, not complete per-frame ground-truth calibration.
threshold_calibration: Front 8, wrist 3, overhead 15 pixel MAE. Overhead aligned reset color/codec variation is below 12; separate +15-frame negative controls are above 59. This is a reset-pose diagnostic, not an exact per-frame visual certification.
